title: Ranzar Malk
subtitle: Independent
description: Operating out of a space station known as the Roost, Ranzar "Ran" Malk put together crews to perform illicit jobs. He ran with the Mandalorian Din Djarin for a time, but the two parted ways. Ran put together a team including the Twi'Lek Xi'an, the Devaronian Burg, and the ex-Imperial sharpshooter Migs Mayfeld. Together with the Mandalorian, Ran had them infiltrate a New Republic prison ship...
